summary: Wall Street's catch-up rally on Friday's NFP surprise (+186K) printed the broadest single-day gain since Nov 2025. Korea +8% historic. Iran Hormuz deadline expires today 18:00 GMT. CPI Thursday, FOMC Minutes Wednesday.
